question.text: Part B of the PMLA Schedule covers offences under which Act, and with what monetary threshold?

answer.text: NDPS Act, with a threshold of Rs. 50 lakh
Customs Act, 1962, with monetary thresholds of 3 million rupees or 10 million rupees as applicable
SEBI Act, with a threshold of Rs. 1 crore
Companies Act, 2013, with no monetary threshold

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.58, Part B of the PMLA Schedule covers offences under the Customs Act, 1962 with monetary thresholds of 3 million rupees or 10 million rupees as applicable. Page 67 lists Section 132 (false declaration, false documents) under Part B. Part A and Part C offences do not carry these monetary thresholds. The Trap: SEBI Act, NDPS Act and Companies Act offences are not in Part B. The Part B threshold is not a single Rs. 1 crore figure; the workbook gives the threshold as 3 million rupees or 10 million rupees, depending on the applicable provision. Note: Read the threshold as stated in the workbook (3 million or 10 million rupees as applicable), rather than collapsing it to a single Rs. 1 crore figure.
